name: branding-iridescent-gradient-nomada-wordmark-with-n-monogram-on-black
title: Wordmark 'Nómada' fading from white through aqua to lilac with a matching N monogram on near-black
whatItIs: A near-black slide with a light geometric sans 'Nómada' whose letters shift from white to aqua to periwinkle, a small ™ and a rounded square monogram of an N made of two shapes in the same gradient.
whatItMeans: Modern and airy; the gradient makes a wordmark feel like light moving across it.
techniques: Apply a single left-to-right gradient across the letters.
Add an accent on the o.
Pair with a monogram in the same gradient.

vocabulary.definition: A soft shifting blend from white to cool colours.
A rounded square holding an initial.
A diacritic used as a design detail.
